> 二十一 学艺 二（第1页）
辰一诺转身看向玉面猫，问道：“母亲，这就是那沈家的大小姐沈沛珊么？怎么一点淑女的样子都没有？大家闺秀哪有这么野蛮的？”
看着辰一诺眼底的笑意，玉面猫知道他正在揶揄着沈沛珊，此刻是想故意激怒她。
于是她故作轻松道：“是啊，这个就是母亲常常和你提起的沈家大小姐。她可是个名门闺秀，琴棋书画，诗词歌赋样样精通。以后你可要跟着她多学着点哦。”
“跟她学？”辰一诺不屑的说道：“跟她学习野蛮无理吗？”说完眼角朝天的，看都不看沈沛珊一眼。
“诺儿，不得无理！当年若不是珊儿的娘亲救了我一命，恐怕现在也没有你的存在了呢。”玉面猫觉得辰一诺的表现有点过分。
“也不知道是谁野蛮？”沈沛珊娇嫩的声音突然响起，气乎乎的鼓起两腮，可爱的一张小脸涨的通红。“好好的猫儿，被你抓在手中，还给它灌下不知是何物的东西，真不知道到底是谁野蛮？”沈沛珊轻抚手中温顺可爱的猫咪，睁大双眼怒视着辰一诺。
“哈哈哈哈……真是好笑！猫儿生病了，不给它服药，难道看着它病的死掉吗？！”
辰一诺盯着沈沛珊，一步步逼近她。
沈沛珊此刻才正面看清辰一诺的容貌，继承了天下第一美男的全部优点的辰一诺，此刻已经是个小美男了，甚至他的父亲更俊美些，尤其是他那双迷人的丹凤眼，狭长上翘的眼尾，乌黑浓密的睫毛，直挺的鼻梁，微抿的薄唇。
辰一诺直至距离沈沛珊仅寸许远时方才停下，她甚至能够感觉到他吹到她脸上温热的呼吸。
“我又不知道是猫儿生病了，我只看到你把它弄痛了。谁让你不解释清楚呢？”沈沛珊弱弱的说道。
抢过沈沛珊手中的猫儿，辰一诺没有再理她，专心的给猫儿吃药。
从此这对师兄妹就开始暗暗比拼，一直都努力的让自己的医术超越对方。
玉面猫果然是倾囊相授，从毒药到解药，从病理到医理，能够教的，全部都教给了沈沛珊。
因沈沛珊一心只想学习医术，而辰一诺则是对玉面猫的轻功和武功也很用心。所以在医术上始终比沈沛珊要差上一层，而辰一诺的轻功和武艺，却是足矣独步武林。
时光荏苒，岁月流梭。转眼六年的时间过去了，在御史沈大人一封又一封信的催促下，沈沛珊无奈离开山谷。
辰一诺以保护不会武功的小师妹为由，硬是赖着沈沛珊一起出了山谷。
途经感业寺时，沈沛珊遇见了改变自己一生的男人——蓝烨磊。两人一见倾心，互许终身。

那时候的蓝烨磊已是征战沙场的大将军，后蓝烨磊去沈家提亲，不久后两人完婚。
辰一诺还未曾表白，就失恋了。于是将这份感情藏于心中，浪迹天涯。

The latest chapter of The Reborn Daughter Wushuang_Twenty-One Learning Arts 2 Page 1_The Reborn Daughter Wushuang Ruffian Snow_Hot Novel Network
> Twenty-one Learning and Art 2 (Page 1)
Chen Yinuo turned to look at the jade-faced cat and asked: "Mother, is this the eldest lady of the Shen family, Shen Peishan? Why doesn't she look like a lady at all? How can any lady be so barbaric?"
Seeing the smile in Chen Yinuo's eyes, the jade-faced cat knew that he was teasing Shen Peishan and wanted to deliberately provoke her at this moment.
So she pretended to be relaxed and said: "Yes, this is the eldest lady of the Shen family that mother often mentioned to you. She is a well-known lady, proficient in music, chess, calligraphy, painting, poetry, and song. You must learn more from her in the future."
"Learn from her?" Chen Yinuo said disdainfully: "Learn from her that is barbaric and unreasonable?" After speaking, the corners of his eyes turned upward, without even looking at Shen Peishan.
"Nuo'er, don't be unreasonable! If Shan'er's mother hadn't saved my life back then, I'm afraid you wouldn't exist now." The jade-faced cat felt that Chen Yinuo's performance was a bit excessive.
"I don't know who is the savage?" Shen Peishan's delicate voice suddenly sounded, her cheeks puffed up angrily, and her cute little face turned red. "A good cat, you caught it in your hands and poured something unknown into it. I really don't know who is so barbaric?" Shen Peishan gently stroked the docile and cute cat in her hand and glared at Chen Yinuo with wide eyes.
"Hahahaha... It's so funny! The cat is sick. If you don't give it medicine, will you watch it die?!"
Chen Yinuo stared at Shen Peishan and approached her step by step.
Shen Peishan only saw Chen Yinuo's face clearly at this moment. Chen Yinuo, who had inherited all the advantages of the most beautiful man in the world, was now a little handsome boy. Even his father was more handsome, especially his charming red phoenix eyes, narrow and upturned eye tails, thick black eyelashes, straight bridge of nose, and slightly pursed thin lips.
Chen Yinuo didn't stop until he was only an inch away from Shen Peishan. She could even feel his warm breath blowing on her face.
"I didn't know that the cat was sick. I only saw that you hurt it. Who told you not to explain clearly?" Shen Peishan said weakly.
After grabbing the cat from Shen Peishan's hand, Chen Yinuo ignored her and concentrated on giving the cat medicine.
From then on, the brothers and sisters began to compete secretly, always trying to surpass each other in their medical skills.
As expected, the Jade-Faced Cat taught everything she could, from poisons to antidotes, from pathology to medical science, and taught Shen Peishan everything she could.
Because Shen Peishan only wanted to learn medical skills, while Chen Yinuo was also very dedicated to the Jade Masked Cat's Qinggong and martial arts. Therefore, in terms of medical skills, he is always one step behind Shen Peishan, but Chen Yinuo's Qinggong and martial arts are enough to stand alone in the martial arts world.
Time flies, years pass by. Six years passed in the blink of an eye. Urged by letters one after another from Master Shen, Shen Peishan had no choice but to leave the valley.
Chen Yinuo relied on Shen Peishan to leave the valley with him on the grounds of protecting his junior sister who did not know martial arts.
While passing by Ganye Temple, Shen Peishan met the man who changed her life - Lan Yilei. The two fell in love at first sight and committed to each other for life.
At that time, Lan Yelei was already a general on the battlefield. Later, Lan Yelei went to the Shen family to propose marriage, and the two got married soon after.
Chen Yinuo fell in love before he could express his feelings. So I hid this feeling in my heart and wandered around the world.
